description: Telecommunications Indicators is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Ministry of Communications and Information Technology. This dataset provides information about telecommunications indicators in the State of Qatar: the number of fixed-broadband subscriptions, active mobile-broadband subscriptions and mobile-cellular subscriptions, and mobile network coverage by technology (at least 2G, 3G, LTE/WiMAX and 5G), for the years 2020 to 2025. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Communications and Information Technology. Its tags are Telecommunications, Broadband, Mobile Subscriptions, Mobile Network Coverage. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
